caption: The drawing is a monochromatic illustration done in shades of gray, depicting a side view of a rooster sculpture positioned on a rectangular base. The rooster is shown with detailed texturing to represent feathers on its body, wings, and elaborate tail, with curved and layered shapes suggesting individual feathers. The bird's head features a comb on top and a wattle underneath its beak, and an eye is distinctly marked. The base beneath the rooster is rectangular with clear shadowing to suggest dimensional depth. A small scale is present in the bottom left corner, marked in inches from 0 to 5. The background is plain, and the only text visible is at the lower right corner, reading "Rollington Campbell."
title: Weather Vane - Cock
